description: Create or edit one tax rate. Omit id to create (name and percentage required); pass id to edit, where every omitted field keeps its value. Names are unique per tenant. isDefault=true makes it the default rate new items take; the preview names the rate that loses the flag. The tenant always keeps a default: the current one stays default until another rate takes the flag, and with no default yet the saved rate becomes it. On an edit the preview counts the items, item groups and customers or vendors that use the rate. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential. For bulk onboarding use upsert_tax_rates.

id.description: The tax rate id (GUID) to edit; omit to create.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

code.description: Short code (e.g. "0", "25"). An empty string clears it.

isDefault.description: true makes this the tenant's default rate, applied to new items (the previous default loses the flag). The tenant always keeps exactly one default, so the current default cannot be switched off here: make another rate the default instead.

name.description: Tax rate name, unique per tenant (case-insensitive). Required when creating.

taxExemptionType.description: Tax exemption type printed on invoices for a 0% rate (e-invoicing). An empty string clears it.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
